description: M7 coverage TARGET manifest for the implemented Story/Nuzlocke Gen1-4 surface. Derived from engine.Phase, the normalized action vocabulary, map_gen's node-type constants, route-oracle/coverage.py's REQUIRED_TAGS and the post-M6.4 battle-oracle corpus -- never from a sweep run's own observed paths. `evidence` names WHICH evidence source is allowed to earn each target.
